title: Team lunch poll
summary: A team lead describes a small tool for their office: each day someone proposes a few lunch places, colleagues vote, and everyone can see which place is winning before noon.
intent: Build a simple daily lunch voting app for a small team to see whether it would replace the group chat back-and-forth.
functional_requirements: Anyone can create today's poll with two to six lunch options, each with a name and an optional note such as price or walking time.
A person enters their name once and can then vote for one option; they can change their vote until the poll is closed.
Results show the number of votes per option as bars, with the leading option highlighted.
The poll creator can close the poll, which announces the winner.
Past polls are listed with their winner and date.
user_stories: As a team member, I want to vote for where we eat so that the choice is quick and fair.
As a team lead, I want to close the poll at a set time so that we can leave together.
As a team member, I want to see past winners so that we don't go to the same place every day.
